title: pm-field-notes-midweek-sprint
summary: Midweek scratchpad capturing PRD copy edits, launch checklist, outstanding action items and quick rollback plan for tomorrow's canary
content:
9:00 — quick sweep: read PRD change log + outstanding comments. Main focus: tighten acceptance criteria for 'latency under 200ms P95' and clarify fallbacks for model variants.

PRD edits to make (short notes):
- Acceptance: change 'P95 < 200ms' -> 'P95 < 200ms for payloads <= 512 tokens; degrade gracefully above 512 tokens (see fallback policy)'. (owner: Ethan)
- Add explicit section for 'model-variant compatibility' (owner: Aisha) with a table: alpha/model-x (quantized) vs alpha/model-x (fp16). Keep rollout mapping.
- Copy: replace generic 'SLO' instances with 'latency SLO' where ambiguous.

Launch checklist (high priority):
- Canary plan: 5% traffic for first 30m -> 25% next 2h -> 100% if no regressions. Add immediate auto-rollback on error rate > 3% or P95 jump > 40%. (owner: Claire)
- Feature-flag gate in console: verify route-level toggle exists and tested in staging. (owner: Marco)
- Monitoring widgets: token cost per request + P50/P95 latency by model variant. Ensure alerts wired. (owner: Observability)
- Runbook: short 'how to rollback' steps, include CLI snippet and dashboard links. (owner: Ethan)

Stakeholder follow-ups (to ping today):
- Ops / Infrastructure: Kate — quick sync about autoscaling headroom for Dedicated pools during canary (ask for 2.5x reserve). (Slack)
- Legal: Sofia — confirm audit-log retention setting for Private customers in this release. (Email)
- Solutions Eng: Raj — need a pre-recorded demo of the console toggle for customers in EMEA. (Request by EOD)

Bugs / risks noticed during staging run: 
- KV-cache warmup slow on long-context (>1024) tests; causes first-request latency spike (~700ms). Possible mitigation: pre-warm cache by replaying sample traces as part of canary. (owner: Marco)
- Small regression in batching when sequence length variance high — causes token-per-second drop. Ticket created JIRA-PLAT-2218. Need triage with runtime team. (owner: Aisha)

Quick triage notes (for standup):
- Blocker: infra team to confirm node pool scaling policy by 15:00 today. If delayed, reduce initial canary to 1% and extend ramp timeline.
- Optional: add temporary rate-limit rule to protect internal endpoints if we hit error spikes.

To-dos (actionable, short):
- [ ] Write the rollback CLI snippet and embed in runbook (Ethan) — due: 2026-03-12 16:00
- [ ] Confirm autoscale numbers with Kate (Aisha) — due: 2026-03-12 15:00
- [ ] Update PRD acceptance criteria + push new PDF to confluence (Ethan) — due: 2026-03-12 18:00
- [ ] Smoke test the feature flag toggle in staging and capture video (Marco) — due: 2026-03-12 17:00
- [ ] Create quick eval set for prompt regressions on 2 edge cases (long-context + truncated-response) (Claire) — due: 2026-03-13

Notes to self / fragments: 
- Consider adding 'canary watch' calendar event with half-hour check-ins the day of launch.
- Might be worth a 'cheap pre-warm' job that runs replay for top 100 prefixes to reduce KV warmup; prototype with solutions-eng.
- Keep marketing in the loop but avoid wide announcement until 24h stable.

Conversation snippets to follow up on: 
- Marco: "we saw the P95 jump only on model-x quantized with big variance; fallback to fp16 seems stable" -> schedule a short deep-dive with runtime tomorrow.
- Raj: "demo should show both toggle and quick rollback in <2 min" -> make script.

End-of-day capture: spent most of morning on PRD wording, afternoon on runbook skeleton and canary thresholds. Next day focus: triage batching regression and finalize canary timeline. 

Unresolved questions (flagged):
- Do we require explicit customer notification for a canary rollback if it affects Hosted API customers? (ask Legal/Comms)
- If pre-warm job runs, what's cost impact for Dedicated pools? (ask Finance)

Random scratch: jot down small CLI for rollback (to refine later):
- redwood rollout cancel --deployment hosted-api-prod --canary-id 2026-03-12-1 --force
- redwood route update --route /v1/generate --model alpha/model-x-fp16

-- Ethan
